title: Barbara
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds of 20 pull-ups, 30 push-ups, 40 sit-ups and 50 squats with exactly three minutes of rest between rounds. An original 2003 Girl; each round is a roughly three-minute all-out interval, so the score is the sum of the five work periods. Scale by cutting reps per round rather than the rest.
